scope: All runtime commands inspected for action/scope/flags and read/write classification. Every recommended ferry domain command is read-only and has substantive description. Framework helpers retain generated metadata; two thin local-list Shorts accepted with concrete rationales. The generic workflow wording, conservative hints for profile use and completion, and generated server hardening are shared-template retro candidates.

recommended_ferry_commands.short: Inspect source cabin type and occupancy, preserving shared-room versus private-room facts
Compare published seasonal fare bands across a bounded Japan date window
Read common baggage, passenger, vehicle, change and normal-ticket cancellation conditions
Return the canonical official booking page and selected planning context
Read distinct source terminal addresses, access guidance and boarding cautions
Simulate source one-way cabin fares for an exact party, vehicle and Japan date
List official route and terminal identifiers from the local reference registry
Search route, Japanese name, terminal or destination offline
Read the official normal weekday timetable and overnight-arrival rules
Discover the source's dated sailings with exact Japan departure and overnight arrival
Official public source metadata; use the planning commands for structured facts
Read the official cabin description page
Read the official English boarding and cancellation policy
Read the official fare and seasonal-calendar page
Read the official port access page
Read the official published weekday timetable page

typed_tools.name: source_cabins
typed_tools.description: Read the official cabin page as raw source HTML. Required: route, one of osaka-beppu, kobe-oita or osaka-shibushi. Prefer the cabins command mirror for bounded cabin and occupancy planning facts.

typed_tools.name: source_conditions
typed_tools.description: Read the official English boarding and cancellation page as raw source HTML. No parameters. Prefer the conditions command mirror for bounded check-in, baggage and normal-ticket cancellation facts with explicit limitations.

typed_tools.name: source_fares
typed_tools.description: Read the official fare page as raw source HTML. Required: route, one of osaka-beppu, kobe-oita or osaka-shibushi. Prefer calendar for explicit seasonal dates and quote for the anonymous party-and-vehicle fare simulation; page marketing prices are not current quotes.

typed_tools.name: source_terminal
typed_tools.description: Read the official port-access page as raw source HTML. Required: route, one of osaka-beppu, kobe-oita or osaka-shibushi. Prefer the ports command mirror for bounded terminal identities, addresses and access guidance.

typed_tools.name: source_timetable
typed_tools.description: Read the official normal weekday timetable page as raw source HTML. Required: route, one of osaka-beppu, kobe-oita or osaka-shibushi. Prefer routes show for parsed weekday patterns, or sailings for an exact dated source lookup; a normal pattern does not establish operation on a date.
